name: Unsafe Deserialization Guard
summary: Block newly introduced executable or unsafe deserialization primitives.
description: Scans bounded proposed source content after masking comments and quoted text, then blocks net-new calls to known unsafe deserializers across common languages.
refuses: It does not deserialize supplied data or execute parser code.
It does not replace a threat model for custom protocols.
It does not treat safe parser names inside documentation as executable calls.

entrypoints.purpose: Block newly introduced executable or unsafe deserialization primitives.
